woe.text: Agatha is one of three witch sisters who, with Eriette and Hylda, help Talion cast the Wicked Slumber to end the New Phyrexian Invasion, and Talion gives her the Vile Cauldron.

She begins influencing the forest animals from her cabin near Dunbarrow, befriending the beasts of the wilds so that under her influence they grow bolder and more savage, and she enchants the woodsman Peter into the Wolf Knight.
With Peter's help she captures Syr Imodane and prepares to cook her, so Talion hands the task to Kellan, promising information about his father.
Kellan slams into Agatha, who falls screaming into her cauldron, and he rescues Imodane as the Wolf Knight is revealed to be Peter.
